gaps.sentence: New technology has ___ the way we work (REVOLUTION).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ise forms the verb: revolutionise. After 'has' the past participle 'revolutionised' is needed.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (DETERMINE) to become a doctor never wavered.
gaps.explanation: A noun is needed after 'His': determination (-ation noun); 'determined' is the adjective.

gaps.sentence: He had a happy ___ in the countryside (CHILD).
gaps.hint: noun needed: the period of being a child (-hood)
gaps.explanation: The suffix -hood forms period-of-life nouns: childhood.

gaps.sentence: She gave a brief ___ of her plans (DESCRIBE).
gaps.explanation: After 'a brief' a noun is needed: description (-tion).

gaps.sentence: The training course will ___ you to work abroad (QUALIFY).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ify forms the verb: qualify. A base verb follows 'will'.

gaps.sentence: The hospital provides ___ care around the clock (PERSON).
gaps.hint: adjective needed before the noun 'care'; beware the word meaning 'staff'
gaps.explanation: 'Personal care' uses the adjective 'personal'; 'personnel' is a noun meaning staff.

gaps.sentence: He made a ___ mistake and lost all the data (CARE).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -less means without: careless means not taking care. It modifies the noun 'mistake'.

gaps.sentence: She showed great ___ in dealing with the crisis (ABLE).
gaps.explanation: After 'great' a positive noun is needed: ability (-ity); 'inability' is the negative opposite.
